# metadata_tools


## FAIR-Data Station

The `fair_ds` repository and its contents, such as `fairds_ontology.py`, are for modifying and testing the metadata ontology files of the FAIR Data Station (FAIR-DS)

## FAIRDOM-SEEK

The `fairdom_seek` repository and its contents, such as `model2seek.py` are for updating, revising, and loading metadata for models in a FAIRDOM-SEEK instance.
